title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Late Fee on the Unpaid Balance
content:
## 1. Unpaid balance of the assessed invoice

1.1 Such an invoice's unpaid balance on the assessment day is its own balance as it stood at the end of the day before the assessment day: its own charge lines other than late-fee lines, a line added after its posting day and before its due date included, less every payment, service credit and credit memo applied to it by then, the payments counting in full against those lines. Late fees are not themselves assessed late fees, so no late-fee line enters that balance.

1.2 Every other invoice being settled in full with its late fees, that balance is every charge on the agreement's billing ledger less every payment, service credit and credit memo on it, leaving out the entries posted on the assessment day itself, and less the late fees the assessed invoice carries, which are the late fees on the invoice carrying the agreement's most recent late fee when that invoice still has an amount unpaid.

## 2. Late fee

The late fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services invoice is the tier's late fee per month percent of the unpaid balance, rounded half up to the cent, or the tier's minimum late fee if that is greater.

The fee is assembled in a fixed order: the values and the method used are fixed first; any percentage reductions are then added into one combined percentage, applied once and rounded half up to the cent; the minimum applies last, the greater of the two being the fee.

## 3. Worked example (hypothetical ledger)

| Invoice | Charges other than late fees | Late fees | Payments, credits, memos |
|---|---|---|---|
| Earlier invoice, settled | 3000.00 | 45.00 | 3045.00 |
| Assessed invoice | 3000.00 monthly fee and 200.00 labor | 50.00, the most recent late fee | 1200.00 |

Ledger view of 1.2: charges 6295.00, less 4245.00 of payments, credits and memos, less the 50.00 late fee the assessed invoice carries, gives 2000.00, the same as the invoice's own balance under 1.1 (3200.00 less 1200.00).

At a late fee of 1.5 percent the fee is 30.00; against a minimum of 35.00 the fee is 35.00. On a balance of 4000.00 the fee would be 60.00.
